nodes.instructions:
Create a county-level choropleth map of the Economic Distress Index for the contiguous United States using the 2017–2021 American Community Survey (ACS) 5-year estimates.
Retrieve the ACS variables needed to construct exactly six county-level economic-distress indicators: educational attainment, poverty, unemployment, public assistance or SNAP, Supplemental Security Income (SSI), and household income of $30,000 or less. When an indicator is represented by multiple ACS categories, aggregate the relevant categories first and calculate one rate for that concept. The resulting dataset should contain exactly six indicator rates for each county.
Normalize each of the six indicator rates independently to a 0–1 scale using min-max normalization across U.S. counties. Give all six indicators equal weight and calculate the Economic Distress Index as their arithmetic mean. Higher index values should represent greater economic distress.
Obtain the 2024 U.S. Census Cartographic Boundary county geometries and join the Economic Distress Index to the county polygons using the five-digit county GEOID. Exclude Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, American Samoa, Guam, the Northern Mariana Islands, and the U.S. Virgin Islands so that the map represents only the contiguous United States.
Project the county geometries to NAD83 / Conus Albers (EPSG:5070) before creating the map.
Classify the Economic Distress Index into five classes using the Natural Breaks (Jenks) classification method and the reversed Lajolla sequential color palette and a horizontal colorbar, with lower values on the left and higher values on the right.

NO_DATA_NOTE = "Gray indicates no available index value"

# ── Load and prepare data ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
gdf = gpd.read_file(DATASET_PATH).copy()

if gdf.empty:
    raise ValueError("The supplied dataset contains no features.")

if gdf.crs is not None:
    gdf = gdf.to_crs(5070)

gdf[VALUE_COLUMN] = pd.to_numeric(gdf[VALUE_COLUMN], errors="coerce")
valid_mask = gdf[VALUE_COLUMN].notna()
valid_values = gdf.loc[valid_mask, VALUE_COLUMN]

if valid_values.empty:
    raise ValueError(
        f"No valid numeric values found in '{VALUE_COLUMN}'."
    )

unique_count = int(valid_values.nunique())
class_count = min(CLASS_COUNT, unique_count)

# ── Natural Breaks classification ─────────────────────────────────────────────
if class_count >= 2:
    classifier = mapclassify.NaturalBreaks(
        valid_values.to_numpy(),
        k=class_count
    )
    gdf["_class"] = np.nan
    gdf.loc[valid_mask, "_class"] = classifier.yb
else:
    classifier = None
    class_count = 1
    gdf["_class"] = np.nan
    gdf.loc[valid_mask, "_class"] = 0

# ── Reversed Lajolla sequential palette ───────────────────────────────────────
colors = cm.lajolla_r(np.linspace(0.18, 0.92, class_count))
cmap = ListedColormap(colors)

# ── Optional state boundary overlay ───────────────────────────────────────────
states = None
if STATE_BOUNDARY_COLUMN in gdf.columns:
    state_subset = gdf[[STATE_BOUNDARY_COLUMN, "geometry"]].dropna(
        subset=[STATE_BOUNDARY_COLUMN]
    )
    if not state_subset.empty:
        states = state_subset.dissolve(by=STATE_BOUNDARY_COLUMN)

# ── Figure layout ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
background = "#F7F6F1"
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10), facecolor=background)
ax = fig.add_axes([0.015, 0.16, 0.97, 0.72])
ax.set_facecolor(background)

gdf.plot(
    ax=ax,
    column="_class",
    cmap=cmap,
    vmin=-0.5,
    vmax=class_count - 0.5,
    edgecolor="#FFFFFF",
    linewidth=0.18,
    missing_kwds={
        "color": "#D9D9D6",
        "edgecolor": "#FFFFFF",
        "linewidth": 0.15,
    },
)

if states is not None:
    states.boundary.plot(
        ax=ax,
        color="#4A4A4A",
        linewidth=0.65,
        alpha=0.85,
        zorder=3,
    )

ax.set_title(
    TITLE,
    fontsize=22,
    fontweight="bold",
    loc="left",
    pad=16,
    color="#202020",
)
ax.set_axis_off()

# ── Legend labels ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
minimum = float(valid_values.min())
maximum = float(valid_values.max())

if classifier is not None:
    bins = np.asarray(classifier.bins, dtype=float)
    lower_bounds = np.r_[minimum, bins[:-1]]
    labels = [
        f"{low:.2f}–{high:.2f}"
        for low, high in zip(lower_bounds, bins)
    ]
else:
    labels = [f"{minimum:.2f}–{maximum:.2f}"]

legend_ax = fig.add_axes([0.25, 0.085, 0.50, 0.028])
norm = mpl.colors.BoundaryNorm(
    np.arange(-0.5, class_count + 0.5, 1),
    cmap.N,
)
sm = mpl.cm.ScalarMappable(cmap=cmap, norm=norm)
sm.set_array([])

cbar = fig.colorbar(
    sm,
    cax=legend_ax,
    orientation="horizontal",
    ticks=np.arange(class_count),
)
cbar.ax.set_xticklabels(labels, fontsize=9)
cbar.outline.set_visible(False)
cbar.ax.tick_params(length=0, pad=7, colors="#444444")
cbar.ax.set_title(
    LEGEND_TITLE,
    fontsize=10.5,
    fontweight="semibold",
    loc="left",
    pad=8,
    color="#333333",
)

fig.text(0.25, 0.055, "Lower distress", fontsize=9, color="#777777", ha="left")
fig.text(0.75, 0.055, "Higher distress", fontsize=9, color="#777777", ha="right")
fig.text(0.78, 0.095, NO_DATA_NOTE, fontsize=9, color="#777777", ha="left")
fig.text(0.015, 0.018, SOURCE_NOTE, fontsize=8.5, color="#777777", ha="left")

# ── Save output ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUTPUT_FILE), exist_ok=True)
plt.savefig(
    OUTPUT_FILE,
    dpi=180,
    bbox_inches="tight",
    facecolor=background,
)
plt.close(fig)

print(f"__OUTPUT_PATH__={OUTPUT_FILE}")
print(f"__FEATURE_COUNT__={len(gdf)}")
